query:
SELECT id, slug, 
  LENGTH(content) as total_len,
  LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '\n', '')) as newline_count,
  LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, ';', '')) as semicolon_count,
  SUBSTRING(content, 1, 500) as preview
FROM blog_posts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2;
